premise- The Kappa Swordsmanship, a martial art passed down through generations of the Kappa tribe,
has a promotion test that requires defeating three opponents of the same rank.
Those who lose the match face a harsh fate: their demonic energy is drained into a tentacle bath beneath the arena.
Can Mizuna, the swordsmanship girl challenging for promotion, continue fighting while sending her fellow disciples to the abyss...?
